title: Design System: Imanol Antonio De la Cruz — Portafolio

tape.note: Ramp derived from the opaque base #ded5bb; the token itself is 75% alpha.

display.purpose: The name on the first page only.

h2.purpose: Home section titles, case title and case section titles; 40 px line.

h3.purpose: Role statement, project names, trajectory entries, stack and form titles; 30 px line.

body.purpose: Descriptions, case prose and diagram labels; main text at most 70 characters per line.

small.purpose: Evidence lines, captions, margin notes, evidence numbers; 20 px line.

label.purpose: Buttons, nav links, field labels and small headings; sentence case, never uppercase kickers.

annotation.purpose: Short factual notes in Bic Ink beside drawn arrows.

fontLoading.source: Self-hosted via next/font/google (Schibsted_Grotesk) as --font-schibsted, exposed as --font-notebook.

depth.name: tape-over-print
depth.value: hero: two 84x24 px strips, var(--tape), rotate(+/-6deg), top:-12px; captures: one 80x20 px strip, rotate(-2deg), centred

depth.name: print-on-paper
depth.value: hero: 10 px white border, 1 px graphite edge, rotate(1deg); captures: white sheet, 1 px page-edge image border
depth.purpose: Separates a real screenshot from the page.

depth.name: page-on-desk
depth.value: 1 px page-edge border on desk background

depth.name: spine-fold
depth.value: 18 px linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--paper) 30%, var(--page-edge) 50%, var(--paper) 70%, transparent) with ink stitches 2 px every 40 px
depth.purpose: The one shaded crease; hero spread, featured project at >=1024 px, case spread at >=1280 px.

motion.name: ease-out-ui
motion.purpose: Press, menu panel and menu icon transitions.

motion.name: ink-draw
motion.value: stroke-dasharray 1 on pathLength=1, stroke-dashoffset 1 -> 0, 500ms var(--ease-ink), fill-mode both
motion.purpose: Plays only in the hero (the circled 'backend' and the first three annotation arrows), and in a case diagram only when it sits in the first viewport. Everything below the fold is static. Never loops, never replays on hover.

motion.name: ink-draw-stagger
motion.purpose: Hero annotation arrows draw in reading order.

motion.name: highlighter-sweep
motion.purpose: The hero's single swipe. Never clip-path (it hid wrapped lines on mobile). The case-study swipe on 'Mi aportación' is static.

motion.name: press
motion.value: scale(0.97) composed with existing rotation (primary -1deg), 120ms in / 160ms out, var(--ease-out-ui)
motion.purpose: Tactile feedback on buttons. No hover lift.

motion.name: hover
motion.value: colour only, gated to @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)

motion.name: mobile-menu
motion.value: opacity + translateY(-8px); 200ms open, 150ms close, var(--ease-out-ui); visibility delayed on close
motion.purpose: Panel under the nav bar below 1024 px.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: handled per component: marks fully drawn, highlighter fully shown, no press scale, menu fades without translate, menu icon static, scroll-behavior auto
motion.purpose: No global kill; all information still present.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.note: Design at 360 and 390. Pages stack, margin rule at 20 px, spine replaced by an 8 px double page-edge rule.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.note: Hero spread opens; secondary projects split 3fr/2fr.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.note: Desktop nav replaces the menu panel; featured project splits; trajectory margin notes and two-column contact appear.

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.note: Full 1280 px container; hero padding 60/30/40/60 with margin rule at 40 px; case-study claim/evidence spread opens.

strokeMarks.strokeWidth: 2px for marks in text (tick, ○, circle, nav underline, action arrows); 2.2px for diagram boxes, diagram arrows and trajectory/project ticks; 2.5px for annotation arrows
strokeMarks.caps: round caps and joins; fill none; non-scaling stroke on stretched boxes and underlines
strokeMarks.geometry: Irregular, slightly unclosed SVG paths. Diagram boxes are hand-drawn rectangles with pathLength=1. Never font glyphs.

vocabulary.circle: Around 'backend' in the hero role; -8 px inset, preserveAspectRatio none.
vocabulary.tick: Verified evidence and completed trajectory entries, 20x20.
vocabulary.strike: Unavailable item, reason stated in words.
vocabulary.arrow: 40x20 lead-in for annotations; 16x16 directional arrows in actions; 24x24 down arrows between diagram boxes.
vocabulary.underline: 2 px pen underline for secondary actions; wavering SVG underline for active/hovered nav.
vocabulary.diagram-box: Hand-drawn rectangle around each diagram step.
vocabulary.evidence-reference: 28 px ink ring around a real-text number pairing a claim with its evidence; max 3 per case.

strokeMarks.a11y: Marks are aria-hidden; state prefixes and labels are sr-only text.

narrative.overview:
The site is a quad-ruled notebook lying open on a desk. Warm paper carries a 5 mm (20 px) blue grid and one red margin rule; the author writes over it in Bic-blue ink: a circle around the word that matters, ticks beside verified facts, arrows from a screenshot to what it proves, a pen underline under a secondary action, hand-drawn boxes for an architecture diagram, and circled numbers that tie a claim to its evidence. Real screenshots are printed and taped in, never floated in glass. Set text is graphite in one sturdy grotesk; the hand shows only in strokes, never in a handwriting font.

Density is a working notebook, not a magazine: content sits on the grid, prose keeps a measured line, and every mark carries information. State is written, not lit: ✓ verified, ○ pending, struck through = unavailable. Depth comes only from overlap: tape over a print, a print over the page, a page over the desk. Empty space is never filled with decoration: when a column would be empty, already-published content moves into the margin or the page narrows. The world refuses the dark-neon developer portfolio entirely: no graphite-and-lime HUD, no mono kicker labels, no glass, no glow.

The notebook is professional first. Personality lives in the precision of the marks and the honesty of the annotations (synthetic data labelled as synthetic, pending dates marked pending), not in decoration. Motion is the pen arriving once, at the top of the page, and nowhere else.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper on a slightly darker desk, a 20 px blue quad grid, one red margin rule per page.
Bic-blue ink is the only accent that acts: buttons, links, marks, annotations, diagram boxes, evidence numbers.
One highlighter swipe per page, on the strongest single piece of evidence.
Main text at most 70 characters per line.
Square everything except the evidence-number circle. Slight hand-placed rotation on prints (+1°) and the primary button (−1°).
Depth by overlap only; no blurred shadows.
Irregular SVG ink strokes that draw once in the first viewport and are simply present everywhere else.

rules.name: The One Pen Rule
rules.body: Blue ink is the only colour that marks or acts. Red belongs to the margin and to errors; it never circles, ticks or underlines.

rules.name: The One Swipe Rule
rules.body: One highlighter swipe per page, not per screen. On the home page it sits on the hero evidence only; on each case study it sits on "Mi aportación" only. A second highlight means neither is the strongest.

rules.name: The Set Type Rule
rules.body: Text is always set in Schibsted Grotesk. No handwriting, script or "marker" fonts, ever; the hand is the strokes.

rules.name: The Measured Reading Rule
rules.body: Main text stays at ≤ 70 characters per line (`max-width: 70ch` on profile prose, 65ch on project and case prose, 450 px for the hero description).

rules.name: The Grid Line Rule
rules.body: Headings, small text, labels and component heights snap to the 20 px grid (40 px, 30 px, 20 px lines). Body prose keeps 1.5 for readability and does not chase grid lines; blocks re-align through their margins.

rules.name: The Cell Rule
rules.body: If a measurement is not a multiple of 10 px, it is wrong unless it is a 1–2 px stroke, a 44/48 px touch target or a text measure in ch.

rules.name: The Empty Space Rule
rules.body: «El espacio vacío no se rellena con decoración. Si una columna queda vacía, se reacomoda contenido ya publicado (notas al margen) o se angosta el layout. Las relaciones entre elementos se marcan con referencias numeradas legibles, no con flechas que dependan de la posición.»

rules.name: The Overlap Rule
rules.body: If something must look raised, put it on top of something else. Never add box-shadow, glow, blur or backdrop-filter.

dos: Do keep spacing on the 20 px cell (10 px half-steps), except 1–2 px strokes, 44/48 px touch targets and ch measures.
Do keep main text at ≤ 70 characters per line.
Do draw every mark (circle, tick, ○, arrow, strike, underline, diagram box) as an irregular SVG stroke in Bic Ink (#1f3a93).
Do let the ink draw (500 ms `--ease-ink`, 80 ms stagger) only in the hero, and in a case diagram only when it sits in the first viewport; everything below the fold is static.
Do sweep the highlighter with background-size and `box-decoration-break: clone` (400 ms `--ease-highlighter`).
Do handle reduced motion per component (marks fully drawn, highlighter fully shown, no press scale, menu fade only); there is no global kill.
Do gate hover styles to `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)`.
Do mark state with ✓ verified, ○ pending, struck = unavailable, with the words available to assistive tech.
Do move already-published content into the margin, or narrow the page, when a column would otherwise be empty.
Do tie a claim to its evidence with a numbered evidence reference, at most 3 per case.
Do label synthetic data as synthetic on every taped screenshot.
Do create depth by overlap: tape over print over paper over desk.
donts: Don't use more than one highlighter swipe per page.
Don't fill empty space with decoration, or point at relationships with arrows that depend on position.
Don't animate the highlighter with clip-path; it hid wrapped lines on mobile.
Don't add a hover lift or replay ink on hover.
Don't render an empty form slot when no contact provider is configured.
Don't use handwriting, script or marker fonts.
Don't use gradient text, glass, backdrop blur, glow or blurred drop shadows.
Don't use a dark or neon theme, or any part of the old graphite + lime HUD (Space Grotesk, JetBrains Mono, #101214, #C2F362).
Don't use an "IA" monogram or any generated or simulated portrait; omit the portrait slot until a real photo exists.
Don't show availability indicators, response-time promises or status dots.
Don't invent metrics, proficiency bars, percentages or counts.
Don't use red ink for marks or emphasis; red is the margin and errors only.
Don't use mono or uppercase kicker/eyebrow labels above headings.
Don't use font glyph icons (↗, ↓, ✓ as text) in place of drawn strokes.
